title: Node.js October 21, 2026 security release

cves.summary: Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write permits RCE
dns: validate resolve inputs for null bytes
http: ensure agent data guard works without I/O
crypto: reset random caches across snapshots
permission: check permission model in realpathSync

priorities: Internet-facing services that decompress Brotli (HTTP clients/servers, proxies, zlib.createBrotliDecompress)
TLS clients that connect to user-supplied hosts
forbidden: Do not guess image tags, digests, or package versions
Do not do a major Node upgrade without explicit approval
Do not change base distribution or image flavor without saying so
notes: Electron apps, vendor images and appliances bundle their own Node — flag for vendor updates; do not patch the host Node and claim the app is fixed.
